text:
Reflective Practice
Facilitated by :
Yossi Indra Kusuma, S.Ked., M.Med.Ed.
Unit Medical and Health Professional Education
FKIK UIN Malang
Learning Objectives
Definisi Refleksi
Urgensi Refleksi
Melakukan Refleksi
Learning Objective
Remember
Understand
Apply
Analyze

Create
Define Reflection
•Our experiences have shaped who we are
•Human beings learn and improve from experience
•Experience alone isn’t enough
•Need tool to understanding learning from experience
•An essential step is “noticing”
Define Reflection
•The Latin meaning of reflection is to ‘turn back’ or ‘bend’ which illustrates 
that active recall of an experience can lead to deeper comprehension which, 
in turn, determines how future experiences are dealt with.
•Reflection is seen to be an “essential characteristic for professional 
competence.” (Mann et al., 2007) 
•Reflect on what you have learnt and look at ways to improve your own
performance (GMC, 2016)
Define Reflection
A metacognitive process that occurs before, during 
and after situations with the purpose of developing 
greater understanding of both the self and the 
situation so that future encounters with the situation 
are informed from previous encounter
(Sandars, 2009)
Urgensi Refleksi
 Kemampuan refleksi bagi mahasiswa dan 
praktisi kesehatan untuk : 
1. mendapatkan gambaran (insight) 
dengan mengidentifikasi tindakan apa 
yang dapat dilakukan untuk 
pengembangan atau peningkatan 
kompetensi, dan pengembangan sikap 
mawas diri.
2. mengidentifikasi peluang untuk 
meningkatkan kualitas pelayanan dan 
keselamatan pasien
Reflective Model (1)
Reflective Model (2)
(Rolfe et al, 2001)
Reflective Model (3)
Gibbs reflective cycle explained
 First 3 steps  focus on what happened
 Second 3 steps  focus on how you can improve
6 Steps of reflective
Step 1 : Description
- simply describe what happened
- don’t draw any conclusion
- all you trying to do is set the scene and provide some context
Step 2 : Feelings
- describe the feelings you felt
- don’t evaluate those feeling, just state
Step 3 : Evaluation
- evaluate the experience
- determine what went well and what didn’t go so well
The 6 Steps
Step 4 : Analysis
- What do you think might have helped/hindered the situation
- Explore options, including what academic models or tools might have helped  
  you
Step 5 : Conclusion
- It’s time to draw some conclusions
- What will you do differently next time?
Step 6 : Action Plan
- Create a plan based on your conclusion
- Commit and take action on your plan
Step 1 - Description
 This step is all about describing the situation in detail and just understanding 
what happened
 Questions to ask yourself in this step :
 
What happened?
 
What did you do?
 
Where there others involved in the situation?
 
What did other people do?
 
What was the outcomes of the situation?
Step 2 - Feeling
 Understand what one felt before, during and after the situation
 Questions to ask yourself in this step :
 
What was the feeling before the situation?
 
What was the feeling during the situation?
 
What was the feeling after the situation?
 
If there were others involved, what did they feel during and after the 
situation?
Step 3 - Evaluation
 We start looking objectively at the situation
 Understanding what worked and what didn’t
 Questions to ask yourself in this step :
 
What was positive about the situation? What went well?
 
What was negative about it? What did not go as well as expected?
 
If there was others involved, what did others contribute to?
Step 4 - Analysis
 Understand why the experience was positive or negative
 We separate our aspects that went well or badly and quoestion why it was 
so
 We can include academic literature or tools to aid our understanding
 Questions to ask yourself in this step :
 
Why did things go well?
 
Why did things not go well?
 
What additional knowledge can help me understand the situation better?
Step 5 - Conclusions
 We draw conclusions on what happened
 Summarize the learning and highlit what changes could improve the 
outcome
 Questions to ask yourself in this step :
 
What did I learn from this situation?
 
How could this have a more positive situation for everyone involved?
 
What skilss do I nedd to develop for me to handle a situation like this 
better?
 
Is there anything else I could have done?
Step 6 - Action Plan
 Specific plan of action based on your conclusions
 How you position yourself to do things differently next time it happened
 Questions to ask yourself in this step :
 
How will I develop the skills neede to get better?
 
How will I review my progress?
 
How will I put the new skills acquired into practice?
 
What would I do things differently next time?
Let’s Do It Guys
 Share your experiences on doing teamwork to do task using any 
reflective models
 Write on blank paper in approximately 15 minute
